dedupe_keys.name: satellittdata no norwegian national ground segment for sentinel satellite data

description: satellittdata.no is the Norwegian National Ground Segment for Satellite Data, which gives access to a complete archive of Copernicus Sentinel data, from each mission's launch to the present, for an area covering Norway, the Norwegian Sea, Svalbard, the Greenland Sea and much of the Barents Sea. All Sentinel missions are included in their native formats (Sentinel-1 and 2 in SAFE, Sentinel-3 in SEN3, Sentinel-5P in netCDF), and a rolling archive in CF-NetCDF (365 days of Sentinel-2 and 30 days of Sentinel-1) is served through OPeNDAP for streaming and server-side subsetting, with older CF-NetCDF products on request. The site offers simple and advanced search, Sentinel-2 datacubes, a mosaic tool, a Geonorge Sentinel-2 mosaic, a Sentinel acquisition tool, InSAR Norge, OGC services and a test catalogue endpoint with CSW, OAI-PMH, OGC Records and STAC. Images must be credited as Copernicus Sentinel data; access is free, with a user account for some functions, under the Copernicus terms. Caveats: some services are in test and a few Sentinel-5P products were withdrawn from OPeNDAP. Coverage is Norway and surrounding seas and Arctic areas. It supports hazard exposure analysis such as ground motion from InSAR around roads and railways, snow and ice, and flood mapping; related records are Terrascope and the Dutch Satellietdataportaal.
